Contains information from the BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset, made available under the Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0.

Pimentel, M.A.F., Johnson, A.E.W., Charlton, P.H., and Clifton, D.A. BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset (version 1.0.0), PhysioNet, 2018. https://doi.org/10.13026/C2208R. Original study: Pimentel et al., Towards a Robust Estimation of Respiratory Rate from Pulse Oximeters, IEEE TBME 64(8):1914–1923, doi:10.1109/TBME.2016.2613124.

Source: https://physionet.org/content/bidmc/1.0.0/

https://physionet.org/content/bidmc/view-license/1.0.0/

Actual de-identified hospital-monitor numerics from a critically ill patient during care at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Boston, USA. This terrestrial clinical recording demonstrates plotting of real measurements. It is not astronaut data, a healthy reference population, or evidence validating this application for spaceflight.

Original CSV retained alongside this JSON. All 481 rows mapped without filtering, interpolation, resampling, or synthetic values; column names normalized. Original NaN values represented as JSON null (13 oxygen and 13 pulse samples). Descriptive statistics calculated from nonmissing values.
SHA256 original CSV: 27d43794cf2e7150db10e8bfe61d2bfdb26873a8f1629ffc5fbee5c9a4eb6ef5
